name: pi-context-cap
notes: Forked from lukeramsden/pi-context-cap (npm @lukeramsden/pi-context-cap v1.0.1). Local divergence per openspec change fork-pi-context-cap: (1) npm renamed to @xzzpig/pi-context-cap, fork version 0.1.0 (now 0.1.3); (2) added config file support (global context-cap.json + project .pi/context-cap.json, key-level merge, project trusted guard) with models whitelist (minimatch provider/modelId or bare modelId), budget/reserve from config; (3) session tri-state override /context-cap on|off|default (default follows whitelist); (4) fork-only config.ts/whitelist.ts modules are additive — the upstream core logic stays in extensions/context-cap.ts and only wires into them (earlier 'refactored core' wording was misleading); README fork notice + CHANGELOG 0.1.0 fork entry. (6) 2026-09-19: package files keep upstream's own tab formatting (package added to root .prettierignore); .github/workflows are dead in the monorepo and stay byte-identical to upstream; since 0.1.3 the CLI flags use the same strict parser as the config file (200k is rejected with a warning, not truncated); the /context-cap <tokens> command keeps upstream's original parsing.
